page.overview:
What is Adventure Jack-O-Bonnie?

Adventure Jack-O-Bonnie belongs to Five Nights at Freddy's. is an unlockable character in FNaF World.

He can be unlocked by beating FNaF 57: Freddy in Space with at least one, but not all, cupcakes collected. Jack-O-Bonnie is a re-skin of Adventure Nightmare Bonnie to resemble his appearance in Five Nights at Freddy's 4: Halloween Edition. He is a brownish-orange color with hollow eyes and an orangish-yellow glow emanating from him, in a similar fashion to a jack-o-lantern.
